checks.command: uv run research/validators/validate_campaign.py --file research/campaigns/hand-consequence-born-return-admission-v1/campaign.toml && uv run research/validators/validate_convergence.py --file research/campaigns/hand-consequence-born-return-admission-v1/convergence.toml && uv run research/validators/validate_program.py --file research/programs/learner/program.toml

findings: The candidate reuses preserved causal-lineage birth and the exact live return opening; it adds no learner memory, hand identity, ranking change, or default behavior.

A pre-opening origin now produces a typed RejectedBeforeReturnOpened decision, does not write consequence, and leaves the return unanswered; a genuinely later local return remains admitted and consequential.
The local consequence-born admission arm survived with exact replay and natural quiescence.

The hand-release prediction was falsified: nine pre-opening returns were rejected, but later unchanged sensor samples were truthfully born after the prior return opened and still renewed the incumbent.

The candidate preserved boundary-effect safety and zero propagation exhaustion but retained four actual position changes, one physical motor, upper clamp, failed primary closure, and failed perturbation recovery.
All 53 non-ignored core tests passed, two adversarial tests remained explicitly ignored, and the representative warm regression suite completed in 0.43 seconds.
residual_uncertainty: The opt-in candidate is locally supported but scientifically insufficient for hand release and is not adopted as default or organism authority.
The next frontier is a learner-visible physical distinction between actual state change and later resampling; current evidence does not yet establish such an observable.
Stable physical-member novelty is only a proposed discriminator and must not be implemented as renewal memory before matched changed-versus-unchanged traces separate it.
